title: Extracting Cultural Commonsense Knowledge at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Crowdsourced human evaluation (via Amazon MTurk) of extracted commonsense assertions about different countries and geographical regions to measure the percentage of inappropriate or offensive statements (Offensiveness metric).
Crowdsourced human evaluation of extracted assertions about various religious groups to calculate the proportion of outputs considered as offensive or inappropriate material.
Crowdsourced human evaluation of generated and extracted assertions regarding different occupations to identify the presence of offensive or prejudiced content.
